messages:
Rae (PM): dropped frames for the new "Welcome Launchpad" — https://www.figma.com/file/uvwx9999/welcome-launchpad
Rae (PM): decision point: grid of curated sample cards vs single collapsible launch rail. goal: improve first-run exploration without annoying repeat users. need copy + a11y checks + quick research plan.

Maya (Design): cards showcase thumbnails + 1-line intent (chat / ingestion / search). rail is lower-cost visually and can persist a single highlighted sample. cards better for discovery, rail better for low-friction.

Owen (Frontend): cards require lazy image loading and focusable card elements. rail is a smaller component but needs collapse state stored per workspace. both need clear DOM order for keyboard users.

Lily (A11y): quick nits: card title at 13px fails contrast in dark theme; use semantic tokens not hardcoded hex. ensure each card has aria-describedby with short SR text "~5 minutes". when rail appears announce via aria-live="polite". close controls should be first in tab order.

Zack (Devex): analytics plan: event welcome_shown, welcome_variant (cards|rail), welcome_opened, sample_started, welcome_dismissed. add experiment_id and cohort. also gate on telemetry consent.

Ben (Research): propose lightweight intercept on dismiss asking "What prevented you from trying a sample?" for a subsample. also run 8 quick sessions comparing cards vs rail for clarity.

onboard-bot: reminder: run axe smoke and keyboard-nav tests on any PR.

Maya (Design): copy options to test:
- Warm: "Try a sample project — 5 min" CTA: "Open sample"
- Directive: "Start with a sample" CTA: "Use sample"
- Minimal: "Try demo" CTA: "Launch"
Which tone should we A/B?

Rae (PM): prefer Warm first. include the "5 min" microcopy and demo intent. also add a small privacy note on cards that use keys.

Owen (Frontend): CSS sketch for card focus outline:
```css
.launch-card:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); }
```
I'll ensure dom order: close button -> title -> CTA.

Lily (A11y): +1 to explicit SR text for time estimate and privacy note. don't rely on color alone for tags.

Zack (Devex): feature flag key: welcome_launchpad_variant. rollout plan: internal 100% with rail, external 20% cards. metric gates: sample_start uplift + dismiss rate < 10%.

Ben (Research): scheduling 8 moderated calls during canary week. will share script.

Rae (PM): action items: Maya update frames with contrast tokens + warm copy; Owen draft PR with DOM order + lazy load; Lily review PR; Zack add events + flag; Ben run quick sessions. target: Tue EOD for PRs and next Thu for internal canary. :thumbsup:

Maya (Design): on it  will post updated prototypes by tomorrow with mobile stacking.

Rae (PM): thanks all. ping here for blockers.
